pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Frame & Field is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A family laughing together in a bright, sunlit studio

children: We started Frame & Field to make portrait photography feel light — bright rooms, real laughter, and none of the stiff, awkward posing most people dread.
From first babies to fast-growing families, fresh headshots to full personal-branding shoots, we’re here for the moments worth keeping. And every one is easy to book online.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Start with a quick consultation — we’ll talk outfits, timing, location and the feeling you want the photos to have.
We keep it relaxed and playful, follow the energy in the room, and catch the real, in-between moments.
A week or two later you’ll view your gallery and pick the digitals, prints and albums you love.
